verses.sloka: स ताम् पुष्करिणीम् गत्वा पद्म उत्पल झषाकुलाम् ।रामः सौमित्रि सहितो विललाप अकुलेन्द्रियः ॥४-१-१॥
verses.transliteration: sa tām puṣkariṇīm gatvā padma utpala jhaṣākulām ।rāmaḥ saumitri sahito vilalāpa akulendriyaḥ ॥4-1-1॥

translations.english: Arriving with Laksmana at the lake filled with lotuses, lilies and fishes, Rama, his senses oppressed, burst into tears.

verses.sloka: तत्र दृष्ट्वैवा ताम् हर्षात् इन्द्रियाणि चकम्पिरे ।स कामवशम् आपन्नः सौमित्रिम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-१-२॥
verses.transliteration: tatra dṛṣṭvaivā tām harṣāt indriyāṇi cakampire ।sa kāmavaśam āpannaḥ saumitrim idam abravīt ॥4-1-2॥

translations.english: He was glad to see it but sad at the thought of Sita. His passion stirred, his senses shaken, he said this to Saumitri:
translations.hindi: जाते समय अपने छिपाने के लिए हनुमान जीने वानर का रूप छोड़ संन्यासी का वेष धारण किआ

verses.sloka: सौमित्रे शोभते पम्पा वैदूर्य विमल उदका ।फुल्ल पद्म उत्पलवती शोभिता विविधैः द्रुमैः ॥४-१-३॥
verses.transliteration: saumitre śobhate pampā vaidūrya vimala udakā ।phulla padma utpalavatī śobhitā vividhaiḥ drumaiḥ ॥4-1-3॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri Pampa looks beautiful with its water clear as vaidurya, its lilies and lotuses in full bloom and its trees in all their variety.

verses.sloka: सौमित्रे पश्य पम्पायाः काननम् शुभ दर्शनम् ।यत्र राजन्ति शैला वा द्रुमाः स शिखरा इव ॥४-१-४॥
verses.transliteration: saumitre paśya pampāyāḥ kānanam śubha darśanam ।yatra rājanti śailā vā drumāḥ sa śikharā iva ॥4-1-4॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri look at the pleasant forest around Pampa where trees stand splendid like mountainpeaks.

verses.sloka: माम् तु शोकाभि सन्तप्तम् आधयः पीडयन्ति वै ।भरतस्य च दुःखेन वैदेह्या हरणेन च ॥४-१-५॥
verses.transliteration: mām tu śokābhi santaptam ādhayaḥ pīḍayanti vai ।bharatasya ca duḥkhena vaidehyā haraṇena ca ॥4-1-5॥

translations.english: Already saddened due to the abduction of Sita and plight of Bharata, I am tormented by Spring.
translations.hindi: ॥ [ टिप्पणी--मिक्तुरूप अर्थात्‌ संन्यासी का रूप घरे हुए इनुमान ची से सर्वशास्त्रज्ञ व्यक्ति विशेष ने रामलदमण को प्रणाम किश्रा--यह यहां शुङ्का उत्पन्न करता है । इसका समाधान रामानुजीय टीका में इस प्रकारः किया हैं नमस्कार; परिग्रद्दीता भिन्नुवेष विरुद्ध इति चेत्‌ श्रत्यद्ध त वस्तु दर्शन सज्ञाताति विस्मयः सन्‌ अज्ञीकृत मिह्कुरूपं विस्मृत्य अवशा: प्रति- पेदिरे इतिवत्‌ प्रणनामेति न विरोध: । ] ४! उवाच कामतो वाक्यं मृदु सत्यपराक्रमों । राजर्विदेवभतिमो तापसो संशितब्रतो

verses.sloka: शोकार्तस्य अपि मे पम्पा शोभते चित्र कानना ।व्यवकीर्णा बहु विधैः पुष्पैः शीतोदका शिवा ॥४-१-६॥
verses.transliteration: śokārtasya api me pampā śobhate citra kānanā ।vyavakīrṇā bahu vidhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ śītodakā śivā ॥4-1-6॥

translations.english: Though stricken with grief, I feel so delighted to see the auspicious Pampa with its wonderful forest and cool water scattered with flowers.
translations.hindi: हे सुन्दर बर्णबाले ! आप लोग मृगों और अन्य बनचारियां को त्रस्त करते हुए, बन में क्यों आए है

verses.sloka: नलिनैः अपि संछन्ना हि अत्यर्थ शुभ दर्शना ।सर्प व्याल अनुचरिता मृग द्विज समाकुला ॥४-१-७॥
verses.transliteration: nalinaiḥ api saṁchannā hi atyartha śubha darśanā ।sarpa vyāla anucaritā mṛga dvija samākulā ॥4-1-7॥

translations.english: Abounding in lotuses, birds and beasts and vicious serpents moving about, it looks splendid indeed.
translations.hindi: आप लोग पम्पा के तटवती वृक्षों को चारों ओर से देखते हुए इस पुण्य जलबाली नदी की शोभा को बढ़ा रहे हैं

verses.sloka: अधिकम् प्रविभाति एतत् नील पीतम् तु शाद्वलम् ।द्रुमाणाम् विविधैः पुष्पैः परिस्तोमैः इव अर्पितम् ॥४-१-८॥
verses.transliteration: adhikam pravibhāti etat nīla pītam tu śādvalam ।drumāṇām vividhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ paristomaiḥ iva arpitam ॥4-1-8॥

translations.english: The bluishyellow grass, dotted with different kinds of flowers fallen from the trees shines like a carpet spread.

verses.sloka: पुष्प भार समृद्धानि शिखराणि समन्ततः ।लताभिः पुष्पित अग्राभिः उपगूढानि सर्वतः ॥४-१-९॥
verses.transliteration: puṣpa bhāra samṛddhāni śikharāṇi samantataḥ ।latābhiḥ puṣpita agrābhiḥ upagūḍhāni sarvataḥ ॥4-1-9॥

translations.english: Entwined with flowering creepers the treetops are covered all over with rich loads of flowers.

verses.sloka: सुख अनिलोऽयम् सौमित्रे कालः प्रचुर मन्मथः ।गन्धवान् सुरभिर् मासो जात पुष्प फल द्रुमः ॥४-१-१०॥
verses.transliteration: sukha anilo'yam saumitre kālaḥ pracura manmathaḥ ।gandhavān surabhir māso jāta puṣpa phala drumaḥ ॥4-1-10॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri it is the season of spring. The trees are laden with fruits and fragrant flowers. Ecstatic blows the gentle freeze.
translations.hindi: आप कान्तिमान्‌, सुखरूप ओर साँड की तरह मस्तानी चाल चलने बाले हैँ । आप हाथी की सूँड की तरह उतार चढाव वाली लंबी भुजाओ वाले हें । आप बुद्धिमान्‌ ओर पुरुषों में श्रेष्ठ हँ.

verses.sloka: पश्य रूपाणि सौमित्रे वनानाम् पुष्प शालिनाम् ।सृजताम् पुष्प वर्षाणि वर्षम् तोयमुचाम् इव ॥४-१-११॥
verses.transliteration: paśya rūpāṇi saumitre vanānām puṣpa śālinām ।sṛjatām puṣpa varṣāṇi varṣam toyamucām iva ॥4-1-11॥

translations.english: 'Look at the flowering trees sending showers of flowers like water dropping from the clouds, O Saumitri
translations.hindi: , आप दोनों की प्रभा से यह पर्बत प्रकाशित हो रहा है और दोनों ही जन जो राज्य करने योग्य तथा देवतुल्य हैं, इस वन में क्यों आए हैं ?

verses.sloka: प्रस्तरेषु च रम्येषु विविधाः कानन द्रुमाः  ।वायु वेग प्रचलिताः पुष्पैः अवकिरन्ति गाम् ॥४-१-१२॥
verses.transliteration: prastareṣu ca ramyeṣu vividhāḥ kānana drumāḥ  ।vāyu vega pracalitāḥ puṣpaiḥ avakiranti gām ॥4-1-12॥

translations.english: Various forest trees shaken by the force of the wind scatter flowers on the beautiful rocky surface of earth.

verses.sloka: पतितैः पतमानैः च पादपस्थैः च मारुतः ।कुसुमैः पश्य सौमित्रे क्रीडतीव समन्ततः ॥४-१-१३॥
verses.transliteration: patitaiḥ patamānaiḥ ca pādapasthaiḥ ca mārutaḥ ।kusumaiḥ paśya saumitre krīḍatīva samantataḥ ॥4-1-13॥

translations.english: O Saumitri! look, the breeze appears to be playing with the flowers; that are fallen and that are still on the trees.
translations.hindi: आपके नेत्र कमल के सदृश हैं, आप बोर हैं और जटाजूट धारण किए हुए हैँ | आप दोनो की मुखाकृति एक दूसरे से मिलती जुलती हुई सी है । सुमे तो ऐसा जान पड़ता है मानों आप दोनों देवलोक से यहाँ आए हैं ॥ /२॥ - यदच्छयेव सम्प्रापौ चन्द्रसूयो वसुन्धराम्‌ । विशालवक्षसौ वीरौ मानुषौ देवरूपिणौ

verses.sloka: विक्षिपन् विविधाः शाखा नगानाम् कुसुमोत्कटाः ।मारुतः चलित स्थानैः षट्पदैः अनुगीयते ॥४-१-१४॥
verses.transliteration: vikṣipan vividhāḥ śākhā nagānām kusumotkaṭāḥ ।mārutaḥ calita sthānaiḥ ṣaṭpadaiḥ anugīyate ॥4-1-14॥

translations.english: "As the wind shakes the flowers off the branches of various trees the bees bumble in tune with the (whistling) wind.
translations.hindi: मुझे तो ऐसा जान पड़ता है कि मानों चन्द्रमा और सूर्य अपनी इच्छा से घराधाम पर अवतीशे हुए हॉ । आप दोनों जन ऊँचे बत्तःस्थलों से युक्त मनुष्यों का रूप धारण किए हुए क्या कोइ देवता दै 0१३१ | 2.5, Rok लक | समदाविव गोबुपौ--8मदौदश्गोढुके तदशइपभावित । ( रा० ) ४० किष्किन्धाकाण्डे सिंहस्कन्धौ महोत्साही समदाविव गोहपों! ्रायताश्च सुट्रत्ताशच वाहः परिघोपमाः

verses.sloka: मत्त कोकिल सन्नादैः नर्तयन् इव पादपान् ।शैल कन्दर निष्क्रान्तः प्रगीत इव च अनिलः ॥४-१-१५॥
verses.transliteration: matta kokila sannādaiḥ nartayan iva pādapān ।śaila kandara niṣkrāntaḥ pragīta iva ca anilaḥ ॥4-1-15॥

translations.english: "As if the trees are dancing to the music of the cuckoos and to the sound of the wind coming out of the mountain-caves.

verses.sloka: तेन विक्षिपता अत्यर्थम् पवनेन समन्ततः ।अमी संसक्त शाखाग्रा ग्रथिता इव पादपाः ॥४-१-१६॥
verses.transliteration: tena vikṣipatā atyartham pavanena samantataḥ ।amī saṁsakta śākhāgrā grathitā iva pādapāḥ ॥4-1-16॥

translations.english: "Shaken by the strong wind all over, the tops of trees look as if they are knitted together.
translations.hindi: आप सागर, वन विन्ध्याचलं, सेरु पर्वत से विभूषित, इस ससूची प्रथित्री की रक्षा कर सकते हैं | आपके ये दोनों धनुष अदूसुत,चकने और सुनहरी कलई किए हुए हैं

verses.sloka: स एव सुख संस्पर्शो वाति चन्दन शीतलः ।गन्धम् अभ्यवहन् पुण्यम् श्रम अपनयो अनिलः ॥४-१-१७॥
verses.transliteration: sa eva sukha saṁsparśo vāti candana śītalaḥ ।gandham abhyavahan puṇyam śrama apanayo anilaḥ ॥4-1-17॥

translations.english: 'The gentle touch of the breeze that blows, cool like sandalwood, full of pure fragrance, takes away the fatigue of the body.
translations.hindi: ओर इन्द्र के हेमविभूषित वज्ज की तरह शोभा दे रहे हैं। आप दोनों के तरकस भी पैने बाणों से परिपूर्ण हैं जो देखने में बड़े सुन्दर जान पड़ते हे

verses.sloka: अमी पवन विक्षिप्ता विनन्दन्ती इव पादपाः ।षट्पदैः अनुकूजद्भिः वनेषु मधु गन्धिषु ॥४-१-१८॥
verses.transliteration: amī pavana vikṣiptā vinandantī iva pādapāḥ ।ṣaṭpadaiḥ anukūjadbhiḥ vaneṣu madhu gandhiṣu ॥4-1-18॥

translations.english: As if the trees are singing, swayed by the wind, while the bees in the forest, fragrant with honey, hum in tune.

verses.sloka: गिरि प्रस्थेषु रम्येषु पुष्पवद्भिः मनोरमैः ।संसक्त शिखरा शैला विराजन्ति महाद्रुमैः ॥४-१-१९॥
verses.transliteration: giri prastheṣu ramyeṣu puṣpavadbhiḥ manoramaiḥ ।saṁsakta śikharā śailā virājanti mahādrumaiḥ ॥4-1-19॥

translations.english: 'The huge trees in the scenic mountainranges look delightful with their blossoms touching the peaks.

verses.sloka: पुष्प संछन्न शिखरा मारुतः उत्क्षेप चंचला ।अमी मधुकरोत्तंसाः प्रगीत इव पादपाः ॥४-१-२०॥
verses.transliteration: puṣpa saṁchanna śikharā mārutaḥ utkṣepa caṁcalā ।amī madhukarottaṁsāḥ pragīta iva pādapāḥ ॥4-1-20॥

translations.english: With the tops of trees covered with flowers, the black bees hovering (humming) over them, the trees, shaken by the restless wind look like singers. (The trees with the top decked with flowers, the bees like black hair on the head swaying in the wind look like dancing and singing)
translations.hindi: आपके तरकसों के बाण फुसकारते हुए सर्प की तरह स्पर्श “ करते ही शत्र के प्राणो का संहार करने वाले हैं | बड़े लंबे तथा चौड़े और सुनहरी मूँठों बाले ये दोनों खङ्ग केचुली छोड़े हुए सर्पो की तरह लड़ रहें ( टकरा रहे) हैं । में आपसे इस प्रकार ( सभ्यता मूर्वे ) बातचीत करता हूँ; किन्तु इसका क्या कारण है जो आप मुझसे नहीं बोलते ? ॥१८!१६॥ सुग्रीवो नान धमात्मा करिचद्वानरयूथप; । वीरो विनिङ्गृतो! भ्रात्रा जगदृश्रमति दुःखितः

verses.sloka: सुपुष्पितांस्तु पश्य एतान् कर्णिकारान् समन्ततः ।हाटक प्रति संच्छन्नान् नरान् पीतांबरान् इव ॥४-१-२१॥
verses.transliteration: supuṣpitāṁstu paśya etān karṇikārān samantataḥ ।hāṭaka prati saṁcchannān narān pītāṁbarān iva ॥4-1-21॥

translations.english: 'See these Karnikaras in full bloom all over, looking like people clad in yellow silk adorned with golden ornaments.

verses.sloka: अयम् वसन्तः सौमित्रे नाना विहग नादितः ।सीतया विप्रहीणस्य शोक सन्दीपनो मम ॥४-१-२२॥
verses.transliteration: ayam vasantaḥ saumitre nānā vihaga nāditaḥ ।sītayā viprahīṇasya śoka sandīpano mama ॥4-1-22॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri this spring season resonating with the sounds of several kinds of birds, kindles my anguish as I am separated from Sita.
translations.hindi: विनिकृतः--वश्चितः | ( गो० ) ४२ किष्करिन्धाकाण्डे वे धर्मात्मा सुध्रीव आग दोनों के साथ मेत्री करना चाहते हें । मुझे आप प्रन का पुत्र ओर सुग्रीव का मन्त्री जानिए

verses.sloka: माम् हि शोक समाक्रान्तम् संतापयति मन्मथः ।हृष्टम् प्रवदमानश्च समाह्वयति कोकिलः ॥४-१-२३॥
verses.transliteration: mām hi śoka samākrāntam saṁtāpayati manmathaḥ ।hṛṣṭam pravadamānaśca samāhvayati kokilaḥ ॥4-1-23॥

translations.english: 'Kandarpa (Cupid) torments me while I am already griefstricken. The Cuckoo with his challenging cheerfulness mocks me.
translations.hindi: सुम्रीव की प्रीति के लिये ( अर्थात्‌ प्रसन्नता के लिये ) मैंने संन्यासी का रूप धारण किआ हे । क्योंकि में यथेच्छाचारी और यथेच्छ रूप धारण करने वाला हूँ । में ऋष्यमूक पर्वत से यहाँ आया हूँ

verses.sloka: एष दाअत्यूहको हृष्टो रम्ये माम् वन निर्झरे ।प्रणदन् मन्मथाविष्टम् शोचयिष्यति लक्ष्मण ॥४-१-२४॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa dāatyūhako hṛṣṭo ramye mām vana nirjhare ।praṇadan manmathāviṣṭam śocayiṣyati lakṣmaṇa ॥4-1-24॥

translations.english: 'Lakshmana, while I am already lovestricken, the swamphen (gallinule, a marshbird) troubles me with its joyous cackles in the beautiful foreststream.
translations.hindi: बाक्यज्ञ ओर बीर श्रीरामचन्द्र तथा लक्ष्मण से इस प्रकार कह, बाक्यकुराल हनुमान जी चुप हो गए और फिर कुछ न बोले

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा एतस्य पुरा शब्दम् आश्रमस्था मम प्रिया ।माम् आहूय प्रमुदिता परमम् प्रत्यनन्दत ॥४-१-२५॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvā etasya purā śabdam āśramasthā mama priyā ।mām āhūya pramuditā paramam pratyanandata ॥4-1-25॥

translations.english: 'While in the hermitage in the past, my beloved was very glad to hear such sounds, invite me to join her and rejoice again.

verses.sloka: एवम् विचित्राः पतगा नाना राव विराविणः ।वृक्ष गुल्म लताः पश्य संपतन्ति समन्ततः॥४-१-२६॥
verses.transliteration: evam vicitrāḥ patagā nānā rāva virāviṇaḥ ।vṛkṣa gulma latāḥ paśya saṁpatanti samantataḥ॥4-1-26॥

translations.english: 'See, the different kinds of birds flying towards trees, shrubs and vines making wonderful sounds all over.
translations.hindi: अवश्य ही इन्होंने सम्पूर्ण व्याकरण बहुधा सुना है | (अथात्‌ पढ़ा है ; ) कयों।क इन्होंने इतनी बातें कहीं, किन्तु इनके मुख से एक भी बात अशुद्ध नहीं निकली

verses.sloka: विमिश्रा विहगाः पुंभिः आत्म व्यूह अभिनन्दिताः ।भृङ्गराज प्रमुदिताः सौमित्रे मधुर स्वराः ॥४-१-२७॥
verses.transliteration: vimiśrā vihagāḥ puṁbhiḥ ātma vyūha abhinanditāḥ ।bhṛṅgarāja pramuditāḥ saumitre madhura svarāḥ ॥4-1-27॥

translations.english: 'O Lakshmana the female birds praised by their flocks, are united with their male partners. Enjoying the sweet sounds of large black bees, they are singing melodiously.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! ये उन वानरराज महात्मा सुप्रीत्र के मन्त्री हूँ _जिनसे में स्वयं मिलना चाहता था। सो यह उनके मन्त्री स्वयं ही मेरे पास आए हैं ।।२६! ७ टू तमभ्यभाष सोमित्र सुग्रीवसचिवं कपिम्‌ । वाक्यजं मधुरेवाक्येः स्नेहयुक्तमरिन्दम

verses.sloka: अस्याः कूले प्रमुदिताः संघशः शकुनास्त्विह ।दात्यूहरति विक्रन्दैः पुंस्कोकिल रुतैः अपि ॥४-१-२८॥
verses.transliteration: asyāḥ kūle pramuditāḥ saṁghaśaḥ śakunāstviha ।dātyūharati vikrandaiḥ puṁskokila rutaiḥ api ॥4-1-28॥

translations.english: These trees seem to enkindle my passion through all sorts of sounds like the loud cackle of swamphens and the sweet warble of the male cuckoos.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि जिस प्रकार की बातचीत इन्होंने हमसे की है, वैसी बातचीत ऋग्वे इ-यजुर्जेद ओर सामवेद के जाने विना, कोई कर नहीं सकता

verses.sloka: स्वनन्ति पादपाः च इमे माम् अनङ्ग प्रदीपकाः ।अशोक स्तबक अङ्गारः षट्पद स्वन निस्वनः ॥४-१-२९॥
verses.transliteration: svananti pādapāḥ ca ime mām anaṅga pradīpakāḥ ।aśoka stabaka aṅgāraḥ ṣaṭpada svana nisvanaḥ ॥4-1-29॥

translations.english: 'The fire of spring with clusters of Asoka flowers as its charcoal, its coppercoloured tender leaves as flames, the buzz of bees as its crackle will, as if, consume me.

verses.sloka: माम् हि पल्लव ताम्रार्चिः वसन्ताग्निः प्रधक्ष्यति ।न हि ताम् सूक्ष्मपक्ष्माक्षीम् सुकेशीम् मृदु भाषिणीम् ॥४-१-३०॥
verses.transliteration: mām hi pallava tāmrārciḥ vasantāgniḥ pradhakṣyati ।na hi tām sūkṣmapakṣmākṣīm sukeśīm mṛdu bhāṣiṇīm ॥4-1-30॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri my life is meaningless if I cannot see my beloved Sita with her delicate eyelashes, beautiful locks of hair and her sweet voice.
translations.hindi: इतना ही नहीं, प्रत्युत बोलते समय भी इनके मुख, नेत्र ललाट, भौंहे तथा अन्य शारीर का कोई अबयब विकृति को प्राप्त नहीं हुआ

verses.sloka: अपश्यतो मे सौउमित्रे जीवितेऽस्ति प्रयोजनम् ।अयम् हि रुचिरः तस्याः कालो रुचिर काननः  ॥४-१-३१॥
verses.transliteration: apaśyato me sauumitre jīvite'sti prayojanam ।ayam hi ruciraḥ tasyāḥ kālo rucira kānanaḥ  ॥4-1-31॥

translations.english: 'O sinless one, the spring season is dear to my beloved Sita when the outskirts of the forest are filled with voices of the cockoo.
translations.hindi: विनीतस्य--शिक्षितस्व । ( गो० इन्होंने अपने कथन को न तो अंधाधुन्ध बढ़ाया ( जिसे सुनने से जी झच उठे ) और न इतना संक्षिप्त ही किया कि, उसका भाव सममे में भ्रम उत्पन्न हो । अपने कथन को व्यक्त करते समय इन्होंने न तो शीघ्रता की और न विलम्ब ही किआ। इनके कहे बचन हृदयस्थ और कण्ठगत हैं, (अर्थात्‌ बनावटी नहीं हैं अथवा जो अक्षर जहाँ से उठना चाहिए उसे इन्होंने वहीं से उठाया हे |) इनका स्वर भी मध्यम है

verses.sloka: कोकिलाकुल सीमान्तः दयिताया मम अनघः ।मन्मध आयास संभूतो वसन्त गुण वर्धितः ॥४-१-३२॥
verses.transliteration: kokilākula sīmāntaḥ dayitāyā mama anaghaḥ ।manmadha āyāsa saṁbhūto vasanta guṇa vardhitaḥ ॥4-1-32॥

translations.english: 'The fire of grief ignited by Kandarpa (the god of love), enhanced by the effects of spring will certainly consume me soon.
translations.hindi: इनकी वाणी व्याकरण से संस्कारित, क्रमसम्पन्न और न धीमी है और न तेज़ है । जो बातें करते हैं, वे मधुर और अन्य गुणों से युक्त होती हैं

verses.sloka: अयम् माम् धक्ष्यति क्षिप्रम् शोकाग्निः न चिरादिव ।अपश्यत ताम् वनिताम् पश्यतो रुचिर द्रुमान् ॥४-१-३३॥
verses.transliteration: ayam mām dhakṣyati kṣipram śokāgniḥ na cirādiva ।apaśyata tām vanitām paśyato rucira drumān ॥4-1-33॥

translations.english: 'Unable to see my beloved wife, the very sight of these lovely trees intensifies my love for her who shines resplendent in me.
translations.hindi: छाती, कण्ठ, सिर--इन तीन स्थानों से निकली हुई, इनकी अद्भुत वाणी, हाथ में तलवार लिये ( मारने को उद्यत ) शत्रु के कठोर हृदय को भी पिघला देगी, औरों की तो बात ही क्या हे

verses.sloka: मम अयम् आत्मप्रभवो भूयस्त्वम् उपयास्यति ।अदृश्यमाना वैदेही शोकम् वर्धयती इह मे ॥४-१-३४॥
verses.transliteration: mama ayam ātmaprabhavo bhūyastvam upayāsyati ।adṛśyamānā vaidehī śokam vardhayatī iha me ॥4-1-34॥

translations.english: 'When in place of Vaidehi I see spring (with its cool breeze) that used to take away the sweat generated by sensual enjoyment, my sorrow is intensified.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! यदि इस प्रकार का दूत राजा के पास न रहे, तो राजाओं के काये क्यों कर सिद्ध हों !

verses.sloka: दृश्यमानो वसन्तः च स्वेद संसर्ग दूषकः ।माम् हि सा मृगशाबाक्षी चिन्ता शोक बलात्कृतम् ॥४-१-३५॥
verses.transliteration: dṛśyamāno vasantaḥ ca sveda saṁsarga dūṣakaḥ ।mām hi sā mṛgaśābākṣī cintā śoka balātkṛtam ॥4-1-35॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri the cruel breeze of the spring forest torments me as I am now immersed in grief in the absence of my fawneyed beloved.

verses.sloka: संतापयति सौमित्रे कृइरः चैत्र वनानिलः ।अमी मयूराः शोभन्ते प्रनृत्यन्तः ततः ततः ॥४-१-३६॥
verses.transliteration: saṁtāpayati saumitre kṛiraḥ caitra vanānilaḥ ।amī mayūrāḥ śobhante pranṛtyantaḥ tataḥ tataḥ ॥4-1-36॥

translations.english: 'Delightful are the peacocks dancing here and there, their feathers looking like crystal windows flung open by the wind.
translations.hindi: जब श्रीरामचन्द्रजी ने इस प्रकार कहा, तब वचन बोलने में चतुर लक्ष्मण ने पवनतनय एव सुग्रीव के सचित्र वाक्यज्ञ हनुमान जी से कहा

verses.sloka: स्त्वैः पक्षैः पवन उद्धूतैः गवाक्षैः स्फाटिकैः इव ।शिखिनीभिः परिवृतास्त एते मद मूर्छिताः ॥४-१-३७॥
verses.transliteration: stvaiḥ pakṣaiḥ pavana uddhūtaiḥ gavākṣaiḥ sphāṭikaiḥ iva ।śikhinībhiḥ parivṛtāsta ete mada mūrchitāḥ ॥4-1-37॥

translations.english: 'The peacocks intoxicated with passion for the peahens surround them intensifying my longing (for Vaidehi).

verses.sloka: मन्मथ अभिपरीतस्य मम मन्मथ वर्धनाः ।पश्य लक्ष्णम नृत्यन्तम् मयूरम् उपनृत्यति ॥४-१-३८॥
verses.transliteration: manmatha abhiparītasya mama manmatha vardhanāḥ ।paśya lakṣṇama nṛtyantam mayūram upanṛtyati ॥4-1-38॥

translations.english: 'Look at the lovelorn peahen, excited by love, dancing on the moutain slope, O Lakshmana Engrossed in love, she dances for wooing the peacock.
translations.hindi: हे हनुमन्‌! सुम्रीब ने जो तुम्हारे द्वारा हमसे कहलाया है, हम लोग तदनुसार ही करेंगे

verses.sloka: शिखिनी मन्मथ आर्तैः एषा भर्तारम् गिरि सानुनि ।ताम् एव मनसा रामाम् मयुरोऽपि अनुधावति ॥४-१-३९॥
verses.transliteration: śikhinī manmatha ārtaiḥ eṣā bhartāram giri sānuni ।tām eva manasā rāmām mayuro'pi anudhāvati ॥4-1-39॥

translations.english: 'Overwhelmed with love, the enchanted peacock, spreading his wings is running after her, making sounds, as though mocking her.

verses.sloka: वितत्य रुचिरौ पक्षौ रुतैः उपहसन् इव ।मयूरस्य वने नूनम् रक्षसा न हृता प्रिया ॥४-१-४०॥
verses.transliteration: vitatya rucirau pakṣau rutaiḥ upahasan iva ।mayūrasya vane nūnam rakṣasā na hṛtā priyā ॥4-1-40॥

translations.english: 'The peacock's beloved, for sure, has not been abducted by the demon. Therefore, he is dancing in delight in the forest in the company of his beloved.

verses.sloka: तस्मात् नृत्यति रम्येषु वनेषु सह कान्तया ।मम त्वयम् विना वासः पुष्पमासे सुदुःसहः ॥४-१-४१॥
verses.transliteration: tasmāt nṛtyati ramyeṣu vaneṣu saha kāntayā ।mama tvayam vinā vāsaḥ puṣpamāse suduḥsahaḥ ॥4-1-41॥

translations.english: 'It is extremely unbearable for me to stay in the forest during this season of flowers (Spring). Look at the passion even among beasts and birds, O Lakshmana And craving for love, the peahen sports near her mate.

verses.sloka: पश्य लक्ष्मण संरागः तिर्यक् योनिगतेषु अपि ।यदेषा शिखिनी कामात् भर्तारम् अभिवर्तते ॥४-१-४२॥
verses.transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa saṁrāgaḥ tiryak yonigateṣu api ।yadeṣā śikhinī kāmāt bhartāram abhivartate ॥4-1-42॥

translations.english: 'Had the largeeyed Janaki not been stolen, she would have also paid advances to me in this manner with all her love and excitement.

verses.sloka: माम् अपि एवम् विशालाक्षी जानकी जात संभ्रमा ।मदनेन अभिवर्तेत यदि न अपहृता भवेत् ॥४-१-४३॥
verses.transliteration: mām api evam viśālākṣī jānakī jāta saṁbhramā ।madanena abhivarteta yadi na apahṛtā bhavet ॥4-1-43॥

translations.english: Look, Lakshmana—at winter's end the flowers of the forest, laden with blossoms, are of no use to me.

verses.sloka: पश्य लक्ष्मण पुष्पाणि निष्फलानि भवन्ति मे ।पुष्प भार समृद्धानाम् वनानाम् शिशिरात्यये ॥४-१-४४॥
verses.transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa puṣpāṇi niṣphalāni bhavanti me ।puṣpa bhāra samṛddhānām vanānām śiśirātyaye ॥4-1-44॥

translations.english: 'The trees look enchanting with flowers in full bloom, with bees hovering over them. But the flowers fruitlessly drop down on the ground.

verses.sloka: रुचिराणि अपि पुष्पाणि पादपानाम् अतिश्रिया ।निष्फलानि महीम् यान्ति समम् मधुकरोत्करैः ॥४-१-४५॥
verses.transliteration: rucirāṇi api puṣpāṇi pādapānām atiśriyā ।niṣphalāni mahīm yānti samam madhukarotkaraiḥ ॥4-1-45॥

translations.english: The joyful birds, calling sweetly in flocks as though inviting one another, madden me with longing.

verses.sloka: नदन्ति कावम् मुदिताः शकुना  सङ्घशः कलम् ।आह्वयन्त इव अन्योन्यम् काम उन्मादकरा मम ॥४-१-४६॥
verses.transliteration: nadanti kāvam muditāḥ śakunā  saṅghaśaḥ kalam ।āhvayanta iva anyonyam kāma unmādakarā mama ॥4-1-46॥

translations.english: 'If spring reigns wherever my beloved Sita is, she must have been overwhelmed with similar sad feelings like me.

verses.sloka: वसन्तो यदि तत्र अपि यत्र मे वसति प्रिया ।नूनम् परवशा सीता सा अपि शोच्यति अहम् यथा ॥४-१-४७॥
verses.transliteration: vasanto yadi tatra api yatra me vasati priyā ।nūnam paravaśā sītā sā api śocyati aham yathā ॥4-1-47॥

translations.english: 'Spring must not have touched the place where she is now staying. Otherwise how could my Sita with eyes like blue lotus live without me?

verses.sloka: नूनम् न तु वसन्तः तम् देशम् स्पृशति यत्र सा ।कथम् हि असित पद्माक्षी वर्तयेत् सा मया विना ॥४-१-४८॥
verses.transliteration: nūnam na tu vasantaḥ tam deśam spṛśati yatra sā ।katham hi asita padmākṣī vartayet sā mayā vinā ॥4-1-48॥

translations.english: 'Or, if there is spring where my beloved lives, what can that lady of beautiful hips do, threatened by enemies.

verses.sloka: अथवा वर्तते तत्र वसन्तो यत्र मे प्रिया  ।किम् करिष्यति सुश्रोणी सा तु निर् भर्त्सिता परैः ॥४-१-४९॥
verses.transliteration: athavā vartate tatra vasanto yatra me priyā  ।kim kariṣyati suśroṇī sā tu nir bhartsitā paraiḥ ॥4-1-49॥

translations.english: 'Eager to speak with her gentle voice, my young beloved, blessed with eyes like lotus petals, will certainly give up her life, unable to enjoy the spring.

verses.sloka: श्यामा पद्म पलाशाक्षी मृदु भाषा च मेम् प्रिया ।नूनम् वसन्तम् आसाद्य परित्यक्ष्यति जीवितम् ॥४-१-५०॥
verses.transliteration: śyāmā padma palāśākṣī mṛdu bhāṣā ca mem priyā ।nūnam vasantam āsādya parityakṣyati jīvitam ॥4-1-50॥

translations.english: 'My mind makes me feel certain that Sita with her chastity might not be able to live separated from me.

verses.sloka: दृढम् हि हृदये बुधिः मम संप्रतिवर्तते ।न अलम् वर्तयितुम् सीता साध्वी मत् विरहम् गता ॥४-१-५१॥
verses.transliteration: dṛḍham hi hṛdaye budhiḥ mama saṁprativartate ।na alam vartayitum sītā sādhvī mat viraham gatā ॥4-1-51॥

translations.english: 'Sita has her love truly fixed in me. My love for her is equally steadfast.

verses.sloka: मयि भावो हि वैदेह्याः तत्त्वतो विनिवेशितः ।मम अपि भावः सीतायाम् सर्वधा विनिवेशितः ॥४-१-५२॥
verses.transliteration: mayi bhāvo hi vaidehyāḥ tattvato viniveśitaḥ ।mama api bhāvaḥ sītāyām sarvadhā viniveśitaḥ ॥4-1-52॥

translations.english: 'This cool breeze that carries the fragrance of flowers, that is gentle in its touch feels like fire when I think about my beautiful beloved.

verses.sloka: एष पुष्पवहो वायुः सुख स्पर्शो हिमावहः ।ताम् विचिन्तयतः कान्ताम् पावक प्रतिमो मम ॥४-१-५३॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa puṣpavaho vāyuḥ sukha sparśo himāvahaḥ ।tām vicintayataḥ kāntām pāvaka pratimo mama ॥4-1-53॥

translations.english: 'The pleasant touch of the wind, which made me happy in the company of Sita intensifies my grief now in her absence.

verses.sloka: सदा सुखम् अहम् मन्ये यम् पुरा सह सीताया ।मारुतः स विना सीताम् शोक संजनओ मम  ॥४-१-५४॥
verses.transliteration: sadā sukham aham manye yam purā saha sītāyā ।mārutaḥ sa vinā sītām śoka saṁjanao mama  ॥4-1-54॥

translations.english: 'The crow that cried unhappily flying in the sky as if to foretell my separation from Sita, is now on the tree, singing joyfully (suggesting my possible union with Sita).

verses.sloka: ताम् विन अथ विहङ्गो असौ पक्षी प्रणदितः तदा ।वायसः पादपगतः प्रहृष्टम् अभि कूजति ॥४-१-५५॥
verses.transliteration: tām vina atha vihaṅgo asau pakṣī praṇaditaḥ tadā ।vāyasaḥ pādapagataḥ prahṛṣṭam abhi kūjati ॥4-1-55॥

translations.english: 'The same crow attendant on Vaidehi there will take me to my largeeyed beloved.

verses.sloka: एष वै तत्र वैदेह्या विहगः प्रतिहारकः ।पक्षी माम् तु विशालाक्ष्याः समीपम् उपनेष्यति ॥४-१-५६॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa vai tatra vaidehyā vihagaḥ pratihārakaḥ ।pakṣī mām tu viśālākṣyāḥ samīpam upaneṣyati ॥4-1-56॥

translations.english: 'Losten, O Lakshmana to the sweet warblings of the birds on the blossoming treetops of the forest. My love for her (Sita) enhances with their sweet voices.

verses.sloka: पश्य लक्ष्मण संनादम् वने मद विवर्धनम् ।पुष्पित अग्रेषु वृक्षेषु द्विजानाम् अवकूजताम् ॥४-१-५७॥
verses.transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa saṁnādam vane mada vivardhanam ।puṣpita agreṣu vṛkṣeṣu dvijānām avakūjatām ॥4-1-57॥

translations.english: 'This honeybee is eager to approach the bunch of tilaka flowers in bloom scattered by the wind like a lover advancing towards his passionate beloved.

verses.sloka: विक्षिप्ताम् पवनेन एताम् असौ तिलक मञ्जरीम् ।षट्पदः सहसा अभ्येति मद उद्धूताम् इव प्रियाम् ॥४-१-५८॥
verses.transliteration: vikṣiptām pavanena etām asau tilaka mañjarīm ।ṣaṭpadaḥ sahasā abhyeti mada uddhūtām iva priyām ॥4-1-58॥

translations.english: 'This asoka tree increases (by nature) the sorrow of lovers. Perhaps it make its presence felt in order to intimidate me with the clusters of its flowers scattered by the wind.

verses.sloka: कामिनाम् अयम् अत्यन्तम् अशोकः शोक वर्धनः ।स्तबकैः पवन उत्क्षिप्तैः तर्जयन् इव माम् स्थितः ॥४-१-५९॥
verses.transliteration: kāminām ayam atyantam aśokaḥ śoka vardhanaḥ ।stabakaiḥ pavana utkṣiptaiḥ tarjayan iva mām sthitaḥ ॥4-1-59॥

translations.english: 'O Lakshmana these mangotrees full of blossoms appear like sexited men who have applied fragrant unguents to their bodies.

verses.sloka: अमी लक्ष्मण दृश्यन्ते चूताः कुसुम शालिनः ।विभ्रम उत्सिक्त मनसः स अङ्गरागा नरा इव ॥४-१-६०॥
verses.transliteration: amī lakṣmaṇa dṛśyante cūtāḥ kusuma śālinaḥ ।vibhrama utsikta manasaḥ sa aṅgarāgā narā iva ॥4-1-60॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri O' tiger among men look at the kinnaras wandering here and there, in the wonderful forest around the Pampa lake.

verses.sloka: सौमित्रे पश्य पम्पायाः चित्रासु वन राजिषु ।किंनरा नरशार्दूल विचरन्ति ततः ततः ॥४-१-६१॥
verses.transliteration: saumitre paśya pampāyāḥ citrāsu vana rājiṣu ।kiṁnarā naraśārdūla vicaranti tataḥ tataḥ ॥4-1-61॥

translations.english: 'O Lakshmana look at these lotuses with fine fragrance all over the water glowing like the rising Sun.

verses.sloka: इमानि शुभ गन्धीनि पश्य लक्ष्मण सर्वशः ।नलिनानि प्रकाशन्ते जले तरुण सूर्य वत् ॥४-१-६२॥
verses.transliteration: imāni śubha gandhīni paśya lakṣmaṇa sarvaśaḥ ।nalināni prakāśante jale taruṇa sūrya vat ॥4-1-62॥

translations.english: 'This Pampa with its water clear and fragrant with red and blue lotuses is filled with swans and geese.

verses.sloka: एषा प्रसन्न सलिला पद्म नील उत्पलायुता ।हंस कारण्डव आकीर्णा पम्पा सौगन्धिका युता ॥४-१-६३॥
verses.transliteration: eṣā prasanna salilā padma nīla utpalāyutā ।haṁsa kāraṇḍava ākīrṇā pampā saugandhikā yutā ॥4-1-63॥

translations.english: 'Lake Pampa shines with lotuses with bees on their filaments like the rising sun.

verses.sloka: जले तरुण सूर्याभैः षट्पद आहत केसरैः ।पन्कजैः शोभते पम्पा समन्तात् अभिसंवृता ॥४-१-६४॥
verses.transliteration: jale taruṇa sūryābhaiḥ ṣaṭpada āhata kesaraiḥ ।pankajaiḥ śobhate pampā samantāt abhisaṁvṛtā ॥4-1-64॥

translations.english: 'Frequented by the Chakravakas and surrounded by the wonderful forest with thirsty elephants and deer this Pampa looks beautiful.

verses.sloka: चक्रवाक युता नित्यम् चित्र प्रस्थ वनान्तरा ।मातंग मृग यूथैः च शोभते सलिल अर्थिभिः ॥४-१-६५॥
verses.transliteration: cakravāka yutā nityam citra prastha vanāntarā ।mātaṁga mṛga yūthaiḥ ca śobhate salila arthibhiḥ ॥4-1-65॥

translations.english: 'O Lakshmana look at the lotuses in clear water dashing against one another due to waves caused by the force of the wind.

verses.sloka: पवन आहत वेगाभिः ऊर्मिभिः विमले अंभसि ।पन्कजानि विराजन्ते ताड्यमानानि लक्ष्मण  ॥४-१-६६॥
verses.transliteration: pavana āhata vegābhiḥ ūrmibhiḥ vimale aṁbhasi ।pankajāni virājante tāḍyamānāni lakṣmaṇa  ॥4-1-66॥

translations.english: 'Unable to see my beloved with eyes large like totus petals and an ardent lover of lotuses, I have no desire to live.

verses.sloka: पद्म पत्र विशालाक्षीम् सततम् प्रिय पन्कजाम् ।अपश्यतो मे वैदेहीम् जीवितम् न अभिरोचते  ॥४-१-६७॥
verses.transliteration: padma patra viśālākṣīm satatam priya pankajām ।apaśyato me vaidehīm jīvitam na abhirocate  ॥4-1-67॥

translations.english: 'Oh how adversly disposed is the god of love He makes me remember that auspicious lady with a pleasing voice when she is lost and difficult to reach.

verses.sloka: अहो कामस्य वामत्वम् यो गताम् अपि दुर्लभाम्  ।स्मारयिष्यति  कल्याणीम् कल्याण तर वादिनीम् ॥४-१-६८॥
verses.transliteration: aho kāmasya vāmatvam yo gatām api durlabhām  ।smārayiṣyati  kalyāṇīm kalyāṇa tara vādinīm ॥4-1-68॥

translations.english: 'If the spring that has set in, with the trees in bloom does not kill me, I have once again to endure the agony of love.

verses.sloka: शक्यो धारयितुम् कामो भवेत् अभ्यागतो मया ।यदि भूयो वसन्तो माम् न हन्यात् पुष्पित द्रुमः ॥४-१-६९॥
verses.transliteration: śakyo dhārayitum kāmo bhavet abhyāgato mayā ।yadi bhūyo vasanto mām na hanyāt puṣpita drumaḥ ॥4-1-69॥

translations.english: 'Whatever was endearing to me earlier in the company of Sita, has turned out to be disenchanting without her.

verses.sloka: यानि स्म रमणीयानि तया सह भवन्ति मे ।तानि एव अरमणीयानि जायन्ते मे तया विना ॥४-१-७०॥
verses.transliteration: yāni sma ramaṇīyāni tayā saha bhavanti me ।tāni eva aramaṇīyāni jāyante me tayā vinā ॥4-1-70॥

translations.english: 'Seeing the delicate petals around the lotus buds that look like beautiful eyelids of Sita, my eyes crave for them O Lakshmana

verses.sloka: पद्मकोश पलाशानि द्रष्टुम् दृष्टिः हि मन्यते ।सीताया नेत्र कोशाभ्याम् सदृशान् इति लक्ष्मण ॥४-१-७१॥
verses.transliteration: padmakośa palāśāni draṣṭum dṛṣṭiḥ hi manyate ।sītāyā netra kośābhyām sadṛśān iti lakṣmaṇa ॥4-1-71॥

translations.english: 'The bleeze that blows through the trees carrying the fragrance of the filaments of lotuses feels pleasant like Sita's breath.

verses.sloka: पद्म केसर संसृष्टो वृक्षान्तर विनिःसृतः ।निःश्वास इव सीताया वाति वायुः मनोहरः ॥४-१-७२॥
verses.transliteration: padma kesara saṁsṛṣṭo vṛkṣāntara viniḥsṛtaḥ ।niḥśvāsa iva sītāyā vāti vāyuḥ manoharaḥ ॥4-1-72॥

translations.english: 'Look at the very spectacular karnikara tree with its blossmed branches on the mountain slope towards the southern side of Pampa, O Saumitri

verses.sloka: सौमित्रे पश्य पम्पाया दक्षिणे गिरि सानुषु ।पुष्पितान् कर्णिकारस्य यष्टिम् परम शोभिताम् ॥४-१-७३॥
verses.transliteration: saumitre paśya pampāyā dakṣiṇe giri sānuṣu ।puṣpitān karṇikārasya yaṣṭim parama śobhitām ॥4-1-73॥

translations.english: 'This king of mountains is rich with plenty of minerals and, therefore, generates multicoloured dust particles splattered by the speed of the wind.

verses.sloka: अधिकम् शैल राजोऽयम् धातुभिः तु विभूषितः ।विचित्रम् सृजते रेणुम् वायु वेग विघट्टितम् ॥४-१-७४॥
verses.transliteration: adhikam śaila rājo'yam dhātubhiḥ tu vibhūṣitaḥ ।vicitram sṛjate reṇum vāyu vega vighaṭṭitam ॥4-1-74॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri With leafless kimsuka trees in full bloom all over the mountain ranges they appear beautiful like blazing mountains.

verses.sloka: गिरि प्रस्थास्तु सौमित्रे सर्वतः संप्रपुष्पितैः ।निष्पत्रैः सर्वतो रम्यैः प्रदीप्ता इव किंशुकैः ॥४-१-७५॥
verses.transliteration: giri prasthāstu saumitre sarvataḥ saṁprapuṣpitaiḥ ।niṣpatraiḥ sarvato ramyaiḥ pradīptā iva kiṁśukaiḥ ॥4-1-75॥

translations.english: 'Very closely grown on the banks of Pampa, stand malati, mallika and karavira trees with their clusters of fragrant blossoms.

verses.sloka: पम्पा तीर रुहाः च इमे संसक्ता मधु गन्धिनः ।मालती मल्लिका पद्म  करवीराः च पुष्पिताः ॥४-१-७६॥
verses.transliteration: pampā tīra ruhāḥ ca ime saṁsaktā madhu gandhinaḥ ।mālatī mallikā padma  karavīrāḥ ca puṣpitāḥ ॥4-1-76॥

translations.english: 'Fully blossmed ketaka, sinduvara, madhavi and kunda bushes in spring scatter their fragrance everywhere.

verses.sloka: केतक्यः सिन्धुवाराः च वासन्त्यः च सुपुष्पिताः ।माधव्यो गन्धपूर्णाः च कुंदगुल्माः च सर्वशः ॥४-१-७७॥
verses.transliteration: ketakyaḥ sindhuvārāḥ ca vāsantyaḥ ca supuṣpitāḥ ।mādhavyo gandhapūrṇāḥ ca kuṁdagulmāḥ ca sarvaśaḥ ॥4-1-77॥

translations.english: 'Chiribilva, madhuka, vanjula, bakula, champaka, tilaka and naga varana and kharjura trees are in full bloom.

verses.sloka: चिरिबिल्वा मधूकाः च वञ्जुला वकुलाः तथा ।चम्पकाः तिलकाः च एव नागवृक्षाः च पुष्पिताः ॥४-१-७८॥
verses.transliteration: ciribilvā madhūkāḥ ca vañjulā vakulāḥ tathā ।campakāḥ tilakāḥ ca eva nāgavṛkṣāḥ ca puṣpitāḥ ॥4-1-78॥

translations.english: 'Lotuses and blue asokas are also in bloom. Lodhra trees on the mountainslopes look golden like the lion's mane.

verses.sloka: पद्मकाः च एव शोभन्ते नील अशोकाः ।च पुष्पिताःलोध्राः च गिरि पृष्ठेषु सिंह केसर पिन्जराः  ॥४-१-७९॥
verses.transliteration: padmakāḥ ca eva śobhante nīla aśokāḥ ।ca puṣpitāḥlodhrāḥ ca giri pṛṣṭheṣu siṁha kesara pinjarāḥ  ॥4-1-79॥

translations.english: 'There are trees like ankola, kuranta, churnaka, paribhadraka, mango, patali, kovidara, muchukunda, arjuna, ketaka, uddalaka, shirisha, shimshupa and shava, all in full bloom on the mountain peaks.

verses.sloka: अन्कोलाः च कुरण्टाः च पूर्णकाः पारिभद्रकाः ।चूताः पाटलयः च अपि कोविदाराः च पुष्पिताः ॥४-१-८०॥
verses.transliteration: ankolāḥ ca kuraṇṭāḥ ca pūrṇakāḥ pāribhadrakāḥ ।cūtāḥ pāṭalayaḥ ca api kovidārāḥ ca puṣpitāḥ ॥4-1-80॥

translations.english: 'There are trees like ankola, kuranta, churnaka, paribhadraka, mango, patali, kovidara, muchukunda, arjuna, ketaka, uddalaka, shirisha, shimshupa and shava, all in full bloom on the mountain peaks.

verses.sloka: मुचुकुंद अर्जुनाः च एव दृश्यन्ते गिरिसानुषुकेतक उद्दालकाः ।च एव शिरीषाः शिंशुपा धवाः ॥४-१-८१॥
verses.transliteration: mucukuṁda arjunāḥ ca eva dṛśyante girisānuṣuketaka uddālakāḥ ।ca eva śirīṣāḥ śiṁśupā dhavāḥ ॥4-1-81॥

translations.english: There stand shalmali, kimshuka, red kuravaka, tinisha, naktamala, chandana and syandana trees.

verses.sloka: शाल्मल्यः किंशुकाः च एव रक्ताः कुरवकाः तथा ।तिनिशा नक्तमालाः च चंदनाः स्यंदनाः तथा ॥४-१-८२॥
verses.transliteration: śālmalyaḥ kiṁśukāḥ ca eva raktāḥ kuravakāḥ tathā ।tiniśā naktamālāḥ ca caṁdanāḥ syaṁdanāḥ tathā ॥4-1-82॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri look at the beauty of these numerous flowering trees on the banks of Pampa, entwining creepers with blooming tops.

verses.sloka: हिन्तालः तिलकाः च एव नाग वृक्षाः च पुष्पिताः ।पुष्पितान् पुष्पित अग्राभिः लताभिः परिवेष्टितान्  ॥४-१-८३॥
verses.transliteration: hintālaḥ tilakāḥ ca eva nāga vṛkṣāḥ ca puṣpitāḥ ।puṣpitān puṣpita agrābhiḥ latābhiḥ pariveṣṭitān  ॥4-1-83॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri look at the beauty of these numerous flowering trees on the banks of Pampa, entwining creepers with blooming tops.

verses.sloka: द्रुमान् पश्य इह सौमित्रे पम्पाया रुचिरान् बहून् ।वात विक्षिप्त विटपान् यथा आसन्नान् द्रुमान् इमान् ॥४-१-८४॥
verses.transliteration: drumān paśya iha saumitre pampāyā rucirān bahūn ।vāta vikṣipta viṭapān yathā āsannān drumān imān ॥4-1-84॥

translations.english: 'While the branches of trees swayed by the wind draw close, the creepers follow the trees like lovely women in a drunken state.

verses.sloka: लताः समनुवर्तन्ते मत्ता इव वर स्त्रियः ।पादपात् पादपम् गच्छन् शैलात् शैलम् वनात् वनम् ॥४-१-८५॥
verses.transliteration: latāḥ samanuvartante mattā iva vara striyaḥ ।pādapāt pādapam gacchan śailāt śailam vanāt vanam ॥4-1-85॥

translations.english: 'The wind blows from tree to tree, mountain to mountain, and forest to forest as though content to enjoy all the fragrance.

verses.sloka: वाति न एक रस आस्वाद सम्मोदित इव अनिलः ।केचित् पर्याप्त कुसुमाः पादपा मधु गन्धिनः  ॥४-१-८६॥
verses.transliteration: vāti na eka rasa āsvāda sammodita iva anilaḥ ।kecit paryāpta kusumāḥ pādapā madhu gandhinaḥ  ॥4-1-86॥

translations.english: 'Some trees stood fragrant with profuse flowers and some with buds shining blue.

verses.sloka: केचित् मुकुल संवीताः श्याम वर्णा इव  आबभुः ।इदम् मृष्टम् इदम् स्वादु प्रफुल्लम् इदम् इत्यपि ॥४-१-८७॥
verses.transliteration: kecit mukula saṁvītāḥ śyāma varṇā iva  ābabhuḥ ।idam mṛṣṭam idam svādu praphullam idam ityapi ॥4-1-87॥

translations.english: 'Fascinated by the flowers, the honeybees cling to one or the other, humming, 'this is soft, this is sweet, and this is fullyblossomed.'

verses.sloka: राग युक्तो मधुकरः कुसुमेषु  आवलीयते।निलीय पुनर् उत्पत्य सहसा अन्यत्र गच्छति ।मधु लुब्धो मधुकरः पंपा तीर द्रुमेषु असौ ॥४-१-८८॥
verses.transliteration: rāga yukto madhukaraḥ kusumeṣu  āvalīyate।nilīya punar utpatya sahasā anyatra gacchati ।madhu lubdho madhukaraḥ paṁpā tīra drumeṣu asau ॥4-1-88॥

translations.english: 'The bees greedy for honey move among the trees on the banks of Pampa. Resting for a while, at one place they fly soon to another.

verses.sloka: इयम् कुसुम सन्घातैः उपस्तीर्णा सुखा कृता  ।स्वयम् निपतितैः भूमिः शयन प्रस्तरैः इव ॥४-१-८९॥
verses.transliteration: iyam kusuma sanghātaiḥ upastīrṇā sukhā kṛtā  ।svayam nipatitaiḥ bhūmiḥ śayana prastaraiḥ iva ॥4-1-89॥

translations.english: 'With countless flowers fallen on their own from trees and scattered like a bed of flowers on stone the ground is rendered comfortable enough to relax on.

verses.sloka: विविधा विविधैः पुष्पैः तैः एव नगसानुषु ।विस्तेएर्णाः पीत रक्ताभा सौमित्रे प्रस्तराः कृताः ॥४-१-९०॥
verses.transliteration: vividhā vividhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ taiḥ eva nagasānuṣu ।visteerṇāḥ pīta raktābhā saumitre prastarāḥ kṛtāḥ ॥4-1-90॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri varieties of colourful flowers, some red and some yellow, are spread out on the mountain slopes.

verses.sloka: हिमान्ते पश्य सौमित्रे वृक्षाणाम् पुष्प संभवम् ।पुष्प मासे हि तरवः संघर्षात् इव पुष्पिताः ॥४-१-९१॥
verses.transliteration: himānte paśya saumitre vṛkṣāṇām puṣpa saṁbhavam ।puṣpa māse hi taravaḥ saṁgharṣāt iva puṣpitāḥ ॥4-1-91॥

translations.english: 'Winter has ended and the season of flowers has set in, O Saumitri The trees are full of flowers as if competing with one another.

verses.sloka: आह्वयन्त इव अन्योन्यम् नगाः षट्पद नादिताः ।कुसुमोत्तंस विटपाः शोभन्ते बहु लक्ष्मण ॥४-१-९२॥
verses.transliteration: āhvayanta iva anyonyam nagāḥ ṣaṭpada nāditāḥ ।kusumottaṁsa viṭapāḥ śobhante bahu lakṣmaṇa ॥4-1-92॥

translations.english: 'The trees, crowned with flowers filled with humming bees, look splendid. It appears they are calling one another, O Lakshmana

verses.sloka: एष कारण्डवः पक्षी विगाह्या सलिलम् शुभम् ।रमते कान्ताया सार्थम् कामम् उद्दीपयन् इव ॥४-१-९३॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa kāraṇḍavaḥ pakṣī vigāhyā salilam śubham ।ramate kāntāyā sārtham kāmam uddīpayan iva ॥4-1-93॥

translations.english: 'This duck, entering into auspicious water, sports with its beloved and incites my love.

verses.sloka: मंदकिन्यास्तु यदिदम् रूपम् एतन् मनोररम्  ।स्थाने जगति विख्याता गुणाः तस्या मनोरमाः  ॥४-१-९४॥
verses.transliteration: maṁdakinyāstu yadidam rūpam etan manoraram  ।sthāne jagati vikhyātā guṇāḥ tasyā manoramāḥ  ॥4-1-94॥

translations.english: 'Only Ganga, like Pampa, has such captivating charm. Its beauty and virtues are famous in the world.

verses.sloka: यदि दृश्येत सा साध्वी यदि च इह वसेम हि ।स्पृहयेयम् न शक्राय न अयोध्यायै रघूत्तम  ॥४-१-९५॥
verses.transliteration: yadi dṛśyeta sā sādhvī yadi ca iha vasema hi ।spṛhayeyam na śakrāya na ayodhyāyai raghūttama  ॥4-1-95॥

translations.english: 'O Lakshmna, the best of the Raghu race, if only that chaste Sita appears, we will stay here. I will not wish for the position of Indra or for Ayodhya.

verses.sloka: न हि एवम् रमणीयेषु शाद्वलेषु तया सह ।रमतो मे भवेत् चिन्ता न स्पृहा अन्येषु वा भवेत् ॥४-१-९६॥
verses.transliteration: na hi evam ramaṇīyeṣu śādvaleṣu tayā saha ।ramato me bhavet cintā na spṛhā anyeṣu vā bhavet ॥4-1-96॥

translations.english: 'If I can sport with Sita in this beautiful green grassy land, I will not have any worry, I would not desire for any other pleasure.

verses.sloka: अमी हि विविधैः पुष्पैः तरवो रुचिर च्छदाः  ।कानने अस्मिन् विना कान्ताम् चित्तम् उत्पादयन्ति मे  ॥४-१-९७॥
verses.transliteration: amī hi vividhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ taravo rucira cchadāḥ  ।kānane asmin vinā kāntām cittam utpādayanti me  ॥4-1-97॥

translations.english: 'These trees with their beautiful leaves and varieties of flowers bring me agony as I live in this forest separated from my beloved.

verses.sloka: पश्य शीत जलाम् च इमाम् सौमित्रे पुष्कर आयुताम् ।चक्रवाक अनुचरिताम् कारण्डव निषेविताम् ॥४-१-९८॥
verses.transliteration: paśya śīta jalām ca imām saumitre puṣkara āyutām ।cakravāka anucaritām kāraṇḍava niṣevitām ॥4-1-98॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri look at this lake of cool water filled with, lotuses, chakravakas flying about and ducks floating.

verses.sloka: प्लवैः क्रौञ्चैः च संपूर्णाम् महा मृग निषेविताम् ।अधिकम् शोभते पम्पा विकूजद्भिः विहङ्गमैः ॥४-१-९९॥
verses.transliteration: plavaiḥ krauñcaiḥ ca saṁpūrṇām mahā mṛga niṣevitām ।adhikam śobhate pampā vikūjadbhiḥ vihaṅgamaiḥ ॥4-1-99॥

translations.english: Pampa, filled with swimming, kraunchas and frequented by big animals looks splendid. The joyous warbling of a variety of birds is highly exciting. They kindle my passion for my young, Moonfaced, lotus eyed beloved.

verses.sloka: दीपयन्ती इव मे कामम् विविधा मुदिता द्विजाः ।श्यामाम् चन्द्र मुखीम् स्मृत्वा प्रियाम् पद्म निभ ईक्षणाम् ॥४-१-१००॥
verses.transliteration: dīpayantī iva me kāmam vividhā muditā dvijāḥ ।śyāmām candra mukhīm smṛtvā priyām padma nibha īkṣaṇām ॥4-1-100॥

translations.english: Pampa, filled with swimming, kraunchas and frequented by big animals looks splendid. The joyous warbling of a variety of birds is highly exciting. They kindle my passion for my young, Moonfaced, lotus eyed beloved.

verses.sloka: पश्य सानुषु चित्रेषु मृगीभिः सहितान् मृगान् ।माम् पुनः मृग शबाक्षी वैदेह्या विरहीकृतम् ।व्यधयन्तीव मे चित्तम् संचरन्तः ततः ततः ॥४-१-१०१॥
verses.transliteration: paśya sānuṣu citreṣu mṛgībhiḥ sahitān mṛgān ।mām punaḥ mṛga śabākṣī vaidehyā virahīkṛtam ।vyadhayantīva me cittam saṁcarantaḥ tataḥ tataḥ ॥4-1-101॥

translations.english: Look at the (male) deer happily roaming here and there together with the female deer on the colourful mountain slopes. Separated from the fawneyed Vaidehi, this sight fills my heart with agony.

verses.sloka: अस्मिन् सानुनि रम्ये हि मत्त द्विज गणाकुले ।पश्य अयम् यदि ताम् कन्ताम् ततः स्वस्ति भवेत् मम ॥४-१-१०२॥
verses.transliteration: asmin sānuni ramye hi matta dvija gaṇākule ।paśya ayam yadi tām kantām tataḥ svasti bhavet mama ॥4-1-102॥

translations.english: 'If I find my dear beloved here on these mountain slopes full of passionate birds how happy will I not feel

verses.sloka: जीवेयम् खलु सौमित्रे मया सह सुमध्यमा ।सेवेत यदि वैदेही पम्पायाः पवनम् शुभम् ॥४-१-१०३॥
verses.transliteration: jīveyam khalu saumitre mayā saha sumadhyamā ।seveta yadi vaidehī pampāyāḥ pavanam śubham ॥4-1-103॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri I can be alive and happy if Sita of slender waist enjoys here with me the sweet breeze of Pampa.

verses.sloka: पद्म सौगन्धिक वहम् शिवम् शोक विनाशनम् ।धन्या लक्ष्मण सेवन्ते पम्पाया वन मरुतम् ॥४-१-१०४॥
verses.transliteration: padma saugandhika vaham śivam śoka vināśanam ।dhanyā lakṣmaṇa sevante pampāyā vana marutam ॥4-1-104॥

translations.english: 'O Lakshmana blessed are those who enjoy the breeze filled with fragrance of lotuses of the surrounding forests of Pampa. The gentle and auspicious breeze indeed takes away the sorrow of the mind.

verses.sloka: श्यमा पद्म पलाशाक्षी प्रिया विरहिता मया ।कथम् धरयति प्राणान् विवशा जनकात्मजा ॥४-१-१०५॥
verses.transliteration: śyamā padma palāśākṣī priyā virahitā mayā ।katham dharayati prāṇān vivaśā janakātmajā ॥4-1-105॥

translations.english: 'How can Janaka's daughter with eyes like lotus petals, so young and loving, sustain her life? Away from me, she must be feeling quite dejected.

verses.sloka: किम् नु वक्ष्यामि धर्मज्ञम् राजानम् सत्य वादिनम् ।जनकम् पृष्ट सीतम् तम्  कुशलम् जन संसदि ॥४-१-१०६॥
verses.transliteration: kim nu vakṣyāmi dharmajñam rājānam satya vādinam ।janakam pṛṣṭa sītam tam  kuśalam jana saṁsadi ॥4-1-106॥

translations.english: 'If righteous and truthful Janaka enquires about Sita's wellbeing in the assembly of people, what am I to speak ?

verses.sloka: या मम् अनुगता मन्दम् पित्रा प्रस्थापितुम् वनम् ।सीता धर्मम् समास्थय क्व नु सा वर्तते प्रिया ॥४-१-१०७॥
verses.transliteration: yā mam anugatā mandam pitrā prasthāpitum vanam ।sītā dharmam samāsthaya kva nu sā vartate priyā ॥4-1-107॥

translations.english: Where now is my beloved Sita, who, treading the path of virtue, followed me—unfortunate, banished to the forest by my father?

verses.sloka: तया विहीनः कृपणः कथम् लक्ष्मण धारये ।य माम् अनुगता रज्यात् भ्रष्टम् विहत चेतसम् ॥४-१-१०८॥
verses.transliteration: tayā vihīnaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ katham lakṣmaṇa dhāraye ।ya mām anugatā rajyāt bhraṣṭam vihata cetasam ॥4-1-108॥

translations.english: 'She followed me, O Lakshmana as I was deposed from the kingdom and distraught. Now helpless, how can I live without her?

verses.sloka: तत् चारु अञ्चित पद्माक्षम् सुगन्धि शुभम् अव्रणम् ।अपश्यतो मुखम् तस्याः सीदति इव मतिः मम ॥४-१-१०९॥
verses.transliteration: tat cāru añcita padmākṣam sugandhi śubham avraṇam ।apaśyato mukham tasyāḥ sīdati iva matiḥ mama ॥4-1-109॥

translations.english: 'Unable to see her beautiful, face with auspicious eyes like fragrant lotuses, I feel (so) depressed.

verses.sloka: स्मित हास्यान्तर युतम् गुणवत् मधुरम् हितम् ।वैदेह्याः वाक्यम् अतुलम् कदा श्रोष्यामि लक्ष्मण ॥४-१-११०॥
verses.transliteration: smita hāsyāntara yutam guṇavat madhuram hitam ।vaidehyāḥ vākyam atulam kadā śroṣyāmi lakṣmaṇa ॥4-1-110॥

translations.english: 'When can I listen to Sita's sweet, wholesome and virtuous, incomparable words interlaced with her gentle smile, O Lakshmana?

verses.sloka: प्राप्य दुःखम् वने श्यामा माम् मन्मध विकर्शितम् ।नष्ट दुःखेव हृष्टेव साध्वी साधु अभ्यभाषत ॥४-१-१११॥
verses.transliteration: prāpya duḥkham vane śyāmā mām manmadha vikarśitam ।naṣṭa duḥkheva hṛṣṭeva sādhvī sādhu abhyabhāṣata ॥4-1-111॥

translations.english: My young and faithful beloved used to put up a brave face and speak to me in all propriety to cheer me up in the midst of suffering in the forest whenever I felt tormented by passion.

verses.sloka: किम् नु वक्ष्यामि अयोध्यायाम् कौसल्याम् हि नृपात्मज ।क्व सा स्नुषा इति पृच्छन्तीम् कथम् च अति मनस्विनीम् ॥४-१-११२॥
verses.transliteration: kim nu vakṣyāmi ayodhyāyām kausalyām hi nṛpātmaja ।kva sā snuṣā iti pṛcchantīm katham ca ati manasvinīm ॥4-1-112॥

translations.english: 'O Prince, what can I tell the highminded Kausalya at Ayodhya when she asks the whereabouts of her daughterinlaw'?

verses.sloka: गच्छ लक्ष्मण पश्य त्वम् भरतम् भ्रातृउ वत्सलम् ।न हि अहम् जीवितुम् शक्तः ताम् ऋते जनकात्मजम् ॥४-१-११३॥
verses.transliteration: gaccha lakṣmaṇa paśya tvam bharatam bhrātṛu vatsalam ।na hi aham jīvitum śaktaḥ tām ṛte janakātmajam ॥4-1-113॥

translations.english: 'You may go to Ayodhya, O Lakshmana, to see our loving brother, Bharata. It is not possible for me to survive without the daughter of Janaka'.

verses.sloka: इति रामम् महात्मानम् विलपन्तम् अनाथ वत् ।उवाच लक्ष्मणो भ्राता वचनम् युक्तम् अव्ययम् ॥४-१-११४॥
verses.transliteration: iti rāmam mahātmānam vilapantam anātha vat ।uvāca lakṣmaṇo bhrātā vacanam yuktam avyayam ॥4-1-114॥

translations.english: Thus spoke Lakshmana these befitting, unforgettable words to his hissouled brother, Rama wailing like an orphan:

verses.sloka: संस्थम्भ राम भद्रम् ते मा शुचः पुरुषोत्तम ।न ईदृइशानाम् मतिः मन्दा भवति अकलुषात्मनाम् ॥४-१-११५॥
verses.transliteration: saṁsthambha rāma bhadram te mā śucaḥ puruṣottama ।na īdṛiśānām matiḥ mandā bhavati akaluṣātmanām ॥4-1-115॥

translations.english: 'O Rama, the foremost of men, control yourself. Be blessed. People who are pure at heart do not feel depressed at heart.

verses.sloka: स्मृत्वा वियोगजम् दुःखम् त्यज स्नेहम् प्रिये जने ।अति स्नेह परिष्वन्गात् वर्तिः अर्द्रा अपि दह्यते ॥४-१-११६॥
verses.transliteration: smṛtvā viyogajam duḥkham tyaja sneham priye jane ।ati sneha pariṣvangāt vartiḥ ardrā api dahyate ॥4-1-116॥

translations.english: 'Remembrance of loved ones causes sorrow. Even a wet cotton wick gets burnt by embracing excessive oil. Hence abandon grief.

verses.sloka: यदि गच्छति पतालम् ततो अभ्यऽधिकम् एव वा ।सर्वधा रावणः तात न भविष्यति राघव ॥४-१-११७॥
verses.transliteration: yadi gacchati patālam tato abhya'dhikam eva vā ।sarvadhā rāvaṇaḥ tāta na bhaviṣyati rāghava ॥4-1-117॥

translations.english: 'Even if Ravana escapes into the nether world or into a world still lower, he cannot save himself by any means, O Rama

verses.sloka: प्रवृत्तिः लभ्यताम् तावत् तस्य पापस्य रक्षसः ।ततः हास्यति वा सीताम् निधनम् वा गमिष्यति ॥४-१-११८॥
verses.transliteration: pravṛttiḥ labhyatām tāvat tasya pāpasya rakṣasaḥ ।tataḥ hāsyati vā sītām nidhanam vā gamiṣyati ॥4-1-118॥

translations.english: 'Once the whereabouts of that sinful demon are known he will either deliver Sita or die.

verses.sloka: यदि याति दितेः गर्भम् रावणः सह सीताया ।तत्र अपि एनम् हनिष्यामि न चेत् दास्यति मैथिलीम् ॥४-१-११९॥
verses.transliteration: yadi yāti diteḥ garbham rāvaṇaḥ saha sītāyā ।tatra api enam haniṣyāmi na cet dāsyati maithilīm ॥4-1-119॥

translations.english: 'Even if Ravana enters into the womb of Diti (mother of demons) along with Sita, I will slay him there if he does not return the daughter of Mithila.

verses.sloka: स्वास्थ्यम् भद्रम् भजस्व आर्यः त्यजताम् कृपणा मतिः ।अर्थो हि नष्ट कार्यार्थैः न अयत्ने न अधिगम्यते ॥४-१-१२०॥
verses.transliteration: svāsthyam bhadram bhajasva āryaḥ tyajatām kṛpaṇā matiḥ ।artho hi naṣṭa kāryārthaiḥ na ayatne na adhigamyate ॥4-1-120॥

translations.english: 'O noble prince be blessed. maintain composure. Without making any effort it is not possible to achieve the objective and recoup loss.

verses.sloka: उत्साहो बलवान् आर्य नास्ति उत्साहात् परम् बलम् ।सः उत्साहस्य हि लोकेषु न किंचित् अपि दुर्लभम् ॥४-१-१२१॥
verses.transliteration: utsāho balavān ārya nāsti utsāhāt param balam ।saḥ utsāhasya hi lokeṣu na kiṁcit api durlabham ॥4-1-121॥

translations.english: 'O revered Sire, enterprise is supreme strength. Nothing is difficult in this world for one who is up and doing.

verses.sloka: उत्साहवन्तः पुरुषा न अवसीदन्ति कर्मसु ।उत्साह मत्रम् आश्रित्य सीताम् प्रतिलप्स्याम् जनकीम् ॥४-१-१२२॥
verses.transliteration: utsāhavantaḥ puruṣā na avasīdanti karmasu ।utsāha matram āśritya sītām pratilapsyām janakīm ॥4-1-122॥

translations.english: 'Enterprising men will never be disappointed in their mission. It is possible to get Sita through effort alone.

verses.sloka: त्यज्य काम वृत्तत्वम् शोकम् सम् न्यस्य पृष्टतः ।महात्मानम् कृतात्मानम् आत्मानम् न अवबुध्यसे ॥४-१-१२३॥
verses.transliteration: tyajya kāma vṛttatvam śokam sam nyasya pṛṣṭataḥ ।mahātmānam kṛtātmānam ātmānam na avabudhyase ॥4-1-123॥

translations.english: 'Bardon grief. Give up emotion. You are a great soul. You are not aware of your great accomplishments. (The temporary sorrow has relegated Rama's nobility to the background. Lakshmana is trying to restore the same)'.

verses.sloka: एवम् संबोधितः तेन शोकोपहत चेतनः ।त्य्ज्य शोकम् च मोहम् च रामो धैर्यम् उपागमत् ॥४-१-१२४॥
verses.transliteration: evam saṁbodhitaḥ tena śokopahata cetanaḥ ।tyjya śokam ca moham ca rāmo dhairyam upāgamat ॥4-1-124॥

translations.english: Thus persuaded by Lakshmana, Rama who was hitherto besieged by grief and delusion, could set them aside and regain patience.

verses.sloka: सोऽभ्य अतिक्रामत् अव्यग्रः ताम् अचिन्त्य पराक्रमः ।रामः पम्पाम् सु रुचिराम् रम्याम् पारिप्लव द्रुमान् ॥४-१-१२५॥
verses.transliteration: so'bhya atikrāmat avyagraḥ tām acintya parākramaḥ ।rāmaḥ pampām su rucirām ramyām pāriplava drumān ॥4-1-125॥

translations.english: No more disturbed by delusion, Rama of unimaginable valour, crossed the very brilliant Pampa with beautiful plants floating on its surface.

verses.sloka: निरीक्षमाणः सहसा महात्मा सर्वम् वनम् निर्झर कन्दराम् च ।उद्विग्न चेताः सह लक्ष्मणेन विचार्य दुःखोपहतः प्रतस्थे ॥४-१-१२६॥
verses.transliteration: nirīkṣamāṇaḥ sahasā mahātmā sarvam vanam nirjhara kandarām ca ।udvigna cetāḥ saha lakṣmaṇena vicārya duḥkhopahataḥ pratasthe ॥4-1-126॥

translations.english: The great Rama was overcome with grief while scanning the entire forest with its streams and caves. Engrossed in her thoughts, dejected at heart and inflicted with pain, he set both, accompanied by Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: तम् मत्त मातङ्ग विलास गामी  गच्छन्तम् अव्यग्र मनाः महात्मा ।स लक्ष्मणो राघवम् अप्रमत्तो ररक्ष धर्मेण बलेन च एव ॥४-१-१२७॥
verses.transliteration: tam matta mātaṅga vilāsa gāmī  gacchantam avyagra manāḥ mahātmā ।sa lakṣmaṇo rāghavam apramatto rarakṣa dharmeṇa balena ca eva ॥4-1-127॥

translations.english: The great soul, Lakshmana, striding like a mighty elephant, with a steady mind, followed Rama dutifully, protecting him with his strength.

verses.sloka: तौ ऋष्यमूकस्य समीप चारी चरन् ददर्श अद्भुत दर्शनीयौ ।शाखा मृगाणाम् अधिपः तरस्वी वितत्रसे नैव चिचेष्ट चेष्टाम् ॥४-१-१२८॥
verses.transliteration: tau ṛṣyamūkasya samīpa cārī caran dadarśa adbhuta darśanīyau ।śākhā mṛgāṇām adhipaḥ tarasvī vitatrase naiva ciceṣṭa ceṣṭām ॥4-1-128॥

translations.english: The swiftfooted, mighty king of monkeys saw those two men of wonderful appearance as they were wandering at Rishyamuka. He neither got scared nor showed signs of nervousness.

verses.sloka: स तौ महात्मा गज मन्द गामि शखा मृगः तत्र चिरन् चरन्तौ ।दृष्ट्वा विषादम् परमम् जगाम चिन्ता परीतो भय भार मग्नः ॥४-१-१२९॥
verses.transliteration: sa tau mahātmā gaja manda gāmi śakhā mṛgaḥ tatra ciran carantau ।dṛṣṭvā viṣādam paramam jagāma cintā parīto bhaya bhāra magnaḥ ॥4-1-129॥

translations.english: The great soul, Sugriva, walking slowly like an elephant saw both of them and became despondent, worried and immersed in fear.

verses.sloka: तम् आश्रमम् पुण्य सुखम् शरण्यम् सदैव शाखा मृग सेवितान्तम् ।त्रस्ताः च दृष्ट्वा हरयोः अभिजग्मुः महौजसौ राघव लक्ष्मणौ तौ ॥४-१-१३०॥
verses.transliteration: tam āśramam puṇya sukham śaraṇyam sadaiva śākhā mṛga sevitāntam ।trastāḥ ca dṛṣṭvā harayoḥ abhijagmuḥ mahaujasau rāghava lakṣmaṇau tau ॥4-1-130॥

translations.english: Having seen the mighty Rama and Lakshmana, all other monkeys got frightened and ran into a sacred and safe hermitage. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे प्रथमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the first sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
